summary: Fractional token splitting after tokenizer deploy causing delayed postbacks and missing promotional credits
description:
Issue summary:
ScaleDocs reports that their finalized invoice for 2026-02 contains a line-item shortfall: expected promotional credits that should have offset a high-volume microbatch embedding job were not applied. The customer ran a scheduled nightly microbatch (approx 1.2M tokens) on 2026-02-27 that used our hosted API. They observed provisional credits in Console immediately after the job, but final invoice shows missing promo credit and an unexpected charge of ~USD 1,200.

Impact:
- Customer-facing charge causing billing dispute and finance escalation.
- Potential erosion of trust for enterprise promotional credits on large microbatch workloads.

Environment:
- prod, us-east
- Hosted Redwood API (api.redwood.ai)
- Customer org: scaledocs-prod

Steps to reproduce (provided by customer):
1) Trigger microbatch embedding job via POST /v1/embeddings with batch chunking header X-Redwood-MicroBatch: true.
2) Job splits into ~3,400 microbatches; tokenizer upgrade v1.3.1 (deployed 2026-02-26 22:45 UTC) started normalizing tokens differently and occasionally emits fractional token boundaries for some CJK sequences.
3) Console shows provisional promo credit allocation immediately after job completion (approx -USD 1,200).
4) Final invoice (2026-03-01) does NOT include the promo credit; charge applied.

Logs / evidence supplied by customer:
- Job run ID: job_8a7e2b-20260227
- Sample postback payloads attached (sensitive data redacted) showing 2026-02-27T07:12:03Z postbacks with token_count: 352 and sequence_hash values.
- Screenshot of Console provisional credit line at 2026-02-27T07:20:11Z.

Desired outcome:
- Explanation of root cause and corrective action.
- Retroactive application of promo credit to the finalized invoice or a one-time credit.

Notes:
- Customer is enterprise and on an onboarding promo that should offset the first $10k of non-reserved usage.
- They had a ticket open with Sales about promo terms; Sales confirmed promo id PROMO-ENT-Q1-2026 should be eligible for embeddings.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:30 - Initial triage: billing shows provisional credit issued (provisional ledger id prov_789) and subsequently voided during finalization step; reconciliation job itemized tokens differently than provisional ledger.

2026-03-10 12:05 - Observed that tokenizer v1.3.1 changes CJK normalization leading to fractional-token-edge cases; postback reconciler groups microbatches by sequence_hash and token_count. If token_count changed between provisional and final reconcile, promo-eligibility filter skipped lines where token_count mismatch > 0.5 fractional threshold.

2026-03-11 08:20 - Found out-of-order postbacks: ~1.2% of postbacks for job_8a7e2b arrived after the reconciliation window due to transient downstream queue backpressure (edge proxy failover). These late postbacks caused the reconciler to mark the job as 'incomplete' and remove provisional promo application pending manual review.
2026-03-11 15:40 - Reconciler PR to relax fractional boundary comparison and accept normalized token_count deltas <=1 for promo eligibility created: github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/4123.
resolution_notes: Temporary workaround: manually applied promo credit to customer account (credit id retro_PROMO_ENT_Q1_2026_20260312) and issued invoice memo. Long-term fix: reconciler PR 4123 merged and will be deployed to prod 2026-03-16; tokenizer team to publish deterministic normalization test vectors. Billing to add a guard to preserve provisional credits for 48 hours when microbatch postbacks are incomplete due to out-of-order arrival.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:02 - Sales (J. Liu): Confirmed PROMO-ENT-Q1-2026 applies to this org. Please expedite, customer has finance hold.

2026-03-10 11:15 - Support (A. Patel): Reproduced provisional->final discrepancy in staging by replaying sample postbacks with tokenizer v1.3.1. Opening internal ticket for reconciler and tokenizer owners.

2026-03-11 09:05 - SRE (M. Hernández): Found spike in edge proxy retry rates at 2026-02-27T07:08-07:25Z correlating with late postbacks. Mitigated by scaling consumer pool. Will forward logs to postback team.
2026-03-12 14:22 - Billing (R. Singh): Applied one-time retroactive credit and generated invoice memo. Customer notified and invoice updated. Pending reconciler fix in prod to avoid recurrence.

2026-03-12 16:10 - Customer (ScaleDocs - finance): Acknowledged receipt of credit and requested confirmation once reconciler is live; will close on their side after validation of next monthly invoice.
